children.role_hint: Second signal-path gain/level-shift driver stage. M5 supplies biased PMOS current from vdd using iref_snk, while M6 converts the error-amplifier output net7 into the pass-device gate-drive node net2.

children.netlist:
.subckt pmos_gate_driver_level_shift_stage gnd iref_snk vdd net7 net2
M6 gnd net7 net2 vdd pmos l=l_eab_p w=w_eab_p*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M5 net2 iref_snk vdd vdd pmos l=l_cs_p w=w_cs_p*1 m=1 nf=1

children.role_hint: Core LDO error-amplifier input stage. M2 provides the PMOS bias current from vdd using iref_snk, M4/M3 form the PMOS differential input pair comparing vin against fb, and M8/M7 form an NMOS current-mirror active load producing the first-stage output net7.
children.role_description: Core LDO error-amplifier input stage. M2 provides the PMOS bias current from vdd using iref_snk, M4/M3 form the PMOS differential input pair comparing vin against fb, and M8/M7 form an NMOS current-mirror active load producing the first-stage output net7.
children.netlist:
.subckt pmos_input_error_amplifier_stage gnd iref_snk vdd vin fb net7
M4 net7 vin net5 vdd pmos l=l_eai_p w=w_eai_p*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M3 net6 fb net5 vdd pmos l=l_eai_p w=w_eai_p*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M2 net5 iref_snk vdd vdd pmos l=l_cs_p w=w_cs_p*1 m=1 nf=1
M8 net6 net6 gnd gnd nmos l=l_eal_n w=w_eal_n*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M7 net7 net6 gnd gnd nmos l=l_eal_n w=w_eal_n*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
.ends pmos_input_error_amplifier_stage

children.role_hint: PMOS LDO power/pass output stage with integrated resistive feedback divider. M0 sources load current from vdd to vo under control of net2, while R1/R2 generate fb as the divided-down regulated-output feedback signal.
children.role_description: PMOS LDO power/pass output stage with integrated resistive feedback divider. M0 sources load current from vdd to vo under control of net2, while R1/R2 generate fb as the divided-down regulated-output feedback signal.
children.netlist:
.subckt pmos_pass_device_feedback_network gnd vdd net2 vo fb
M0 vo net2 vdd vdd pmos l=l_power_p w=w_power_p*1 m=1 nf=1
R1 vo fb res r1
R2 fb gnd res r2
.ends pmos_pass_device_feedback_network
